Sample Taxon Reports
```{r}
# List all CSV files in the directory
csv_files <- list.files(path = "/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/experiment_all/sample_taxon_reports", pattern = ".*.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
seq_metrics = read.csv("/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/sequencing_summary_metrics_all.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Process all CSV files and combine them
all_data <- bind_rows(lapply(csv_files, process_csv_file))

# Create a metadata dataframe to merge with taxon data
sample_metadata = seq_metrics %>% 
  select(sample_name, water_control, infection_class) %>% 
  mutate(
  # Library prep: MSSPE if ends with "_M"
  library_prep = if_else(str_ends(sample_name, "_M"), "MSSPE", "NGS"),

  # Remove the _M suffix to get the core sample identifier
  core = str_remove(sample_name, "_M$"),
  # Detect experiment 3 first (Cxxx_LPx)
  is_exp3 = str_detect(core, "C\\d+.*LP\\d+"),

  # Base: first sample ID (e.g. S10, PC1)
  base = str_extract(core, "^[A-Za-z]+\\d+"),

  # Append -2 or -3 only if not exp3
  suffix = case_when(
    !is_exp3 & str_detect(core, "_2$") ~ "-2",
    !is_exp3 & str_detect(core, "_3$") ~ "-3",
    TRUE ~ ""
  ),

  base_sample = tolower(paste0(base, suffix)),

  experiment = case_when(
    is_exp3 ~ 3,
    str_detect(core, "_3$") ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )
) %>%
select(sample_name, base_sample, library_prep, experiment, water_control, infection_class)

# Merge the taxonomy data with metadata
merged_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample_name")

# Filter to include only species level (tax_level == 1) to avoid duplication
all_data_species <- merged_data %>%
  filter(tax_level == 1) %>% 
  filter(experiment == 3) %>%  # filter in specific experiments
  filter(water_control == "No") %>%   # filter out Negative Controls
  filter(!base_sample %in% c("pc1","pc3")) %>%  # filter out zymo fecal controls
  filter(infection_class != "Definite") # filter out positive controls
```

```{r}
species_data_filtered = all_data_species %>% 
  filter(nt_rpm >= 1 | nr_rpm >= 1 | nt_count >=3) %>% # positive inclusion criteria
  filter(nt_alignment_length > 50) 
```

```{r}
# ---- USER PARAMETERS ----
depths <- c(5e5, 1e6, 2e6, 3e6, 4e6, 5e6, 7e6, 9e6, 11e6, 13e6, 15e6, 17e6, 19e6, 21e6)     # Target depths to simulate
n_reps <- 10                        # Replicates per depth
target_taxa <- c("Alphapapillomavirus 7", "Teschovirus A", "Sapporo virus")  # pathogens to track
detection_thresholds <- c(1, 5)  # read thresholds

# specific names that should group together
ent_v = "Enterovirus"
circo_v = "Circovirus"
sapo_v = paste(c("Sapovirus","Sapporo"), collapse = "|")
tes_v = "Teschovirus"
aich_v = "Aichivirus"
astr_v = paste(c("Porcine astrovirus","Mamastrovirus 3"), collapse = "|")
hpv18 = "Alphapapillomavirus"
sapel_v = "Sapelovirus"
boc_v = paste(c("Porcine bocavirus","Bocaparvovirus"), collapse = "|")

# Virus pattern definitions
patterns <- c(
  Enterovirus      = ent_v,
  Circovirus       = circo_v,
  SapovirusGroup   = sapo_v,
  Teschovirus      = tes_v,
  Aichivirus       = aich_v,
  AstrovirusGroup  = astr_v,
  Alphapapilloma   = hpv18,
  Sapelovirus      = sapel_v,
  BocavirusGroup   = boc_v
)
```

```{r}
# Extract sample metadata (one row per sample)
sample_meta <- species_data_filtered %>%
  select(sample_name, library_prep) %>%
  distinct()

# Create wide count matrix: taxa x samples
count_mat <- species_data_filtered %>%
  group_by(sample_name, name) %>%
  summarise(reads = sum(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_name, values_from = reads, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("name")

taxa <- count_mat$name
count_mat <- as.data.frame(count_mat)
rownames(count_mat) <- taxa
#count_mat <- count_mat[ , -1]  # remove tax_name column THIS CAUSES BUG - removed NGS rows from PC2 samples
```

```{r}
# ---- SUMMARIZE RESULTS ----
# Diversity summary
div_summary <- res %>%
  group_by(depth) %>%
  summarise(
    richness_mean = mean(richness),
    richness_sd = sd(richness),
    shannon_mean = mean(shannon),
    shannon_sd = sd(shannon),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

# By library prep
div_summary_libprep <- res %>%
  group_by(depth, library_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    richness_mean = mean(richness),
    richness_sd = sd(richness),
    shannon_mean = mean(shannon),
    shannon_sd = sd(shannon),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

# remove _M from samples names for comparison
res = res %>% 
  mutate(sample = str_remove(sample, "_M.*$"))

res_agg <- res %>%
  rename(richness_val = richness) %>% 
  group_by(sample, library_prep, depth) %>%
  summarise(
    richness_mean = mean(richness_val),
    shannon_mean = mean(shannon),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check one depth in detail
res_agg %>%
  filter(depth == depths[3]) %>%
  select(sample, library_prep, richness_mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = library_prep, values_from = richness_mean)

# do friedman test measuring richness by library prep pairing by sample
friedman_results <- res_agg %>%
  group_by(depth) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(
      friedman.test(richness_mean ~ library_prep | sample)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = map_dbl(test, ~ .$statistic),
    p_value   = map_dbl(test, ~ .$p.value)
  )

# Join friedman results back to the overall table
div_summary = div_summary %>% 
  left_join(friedman_results, by = "depth")

div_summary = div_summary %>% 
  select(-shannon_sd, -richness_sd, -test, -statistic)

div_summary
```

```{r}
# Detection summary
det_cols <- grep("^detect_", names(res), value = TRUE)
det_summary <- res %>%
  group_by(depth) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(det_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-depth, names_to = "target_thresh", values_to = "detect_prob") %>%
  mutate(
    target = sub("^detect_", "", target_thresh),
    target = sub("_ge_.*", "", target),
    threshold = sub(".*_ge_", "", target_thresh)
  )

det_summary %>% 
  group_by(depth, target) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_prob = mean(detect_prob),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = target, values_from = mean_prob)

```



```{r}
# Simulation function: returns detection probabilities for >= thresholds
simulate_thresholds <- function(count, total, depth, boots, thresholds) {
  if (total == 0) return(rep(0, length(thresholds)))

  prob <- count / total
  sims <- rbinom(boots, size = depth, prob = prob)

  sapply(thresholds, function(t) mean(sims >= t))
}

results <- species_data_filtered %>%
  filter(name %in% target_taxa) %>%
  group_by(name, sample_name, library_prep) %>%
  mutate(total_reads = sum(nt_count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(name, sample_name, library_prep, nt_count, total_reads) %>%
  summarise(
    detection = list(
      map(depths, ~ simulate_thresholds(nt_count, total_reads, .x, n_reps, detection_thresholds))
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(depth = list(depths)) %>%
  unnest(c(detection, depth)) %>%
  unnest_wider(detection) %>%
  # rename sequential columns to match thresholds
  rename_with(~ paste0("prob_ge", detection_th), everything()) %>%
  group_by(name, library_prep, depth) %>%
  summarise(
    prob_ge1 = mean(prob_ge1),
    prob_ge5 = mean(prob_ge5),
    prob_ge10 = mean(prob_ge10),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

results
```
